headline: Cameroon Steel Plant Explosion Leaves Four Dead and 16 Injured
summary: An explosion and fire at a steel manufacturing plant in Douala, Cameroon, resulted in four fatalities and left 16 people severely burned.
why: Industrial accidents at key manufacturing facilities can cause local supply disruptions and highlight operational safety and regulatory compliance standards.

impacts.name: Steel
impacts.why: Plant disruption affects local production capacity and operational continuity in the regional steel sector.
